title: Only one tile's details are open at a time
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in a location (workplace) that has invoices and technician clocked time over the last twelve months.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard, switch the Revenue and Technician Efficiency pills to Last 12 Months: both show figures; then set both back to This Month (the dashboard remembers your choices in this browser). If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu and click View details on Revenue.
  2. Click View details on Technician Efficiency.
  3. Click View details on At Risk Customers.
  4. Click the tile's name, headline and trend line on Billing Efficiency.
  5. Click the range pill on Revenue, then click away to close its menu.
  6. Click the window pill on At Risk Customers, then click away.
  7. Hover the arrow icon beside "Sales by Customer", then click it, and go back to the dashboard.
  8. Click View details on the open tile again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Only one detail panel is open at any moment.
  • Opening Technician Efficiency closes the Revenue panel. Opening At Risk closes the Technician Efficiency panel.
  • Clicking a tile's name, headline or trend line does not open or close anything. Only "View details" does.
  • Opening a range pill or the At Risk window pill does not open the tile's details.
  • Clicking the report arrow opens the report and does not open the tile's details.
  • Clicking "View details" on the open tile closes its panel.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9578 (Story 6, Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 6. Design canvas boards 04 to 09 *_After (rows 4 to 9).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R9: “At most one tile's detail is open at a time.”
  • S6-R10: “When the user expands a tile while another tile's detail is open, the previously open detail closes.”
  • S6-R11: “Only the "View details" control expands or collapses a tile.”
  • S6-R12: “Selecting the date-range or inactivity-window control on a tile does not expand the tile.”
  • S6-R13: “Selecting the report link on a tile does not expand the tile.”
  • S6 context note (one panel): “a single-panel expansion was chosen over letting several details open at once, so the user reads one thing at a time and the screen stays short.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
